newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign exchange market volume down in Sept.
newsitem.headline: China foreign exchange market volume down in Sept.

text.p: Volume on China's foreign exchange interbank market fell in September due to an excess of supply over demand, with total turnover for the month amounting to $4.82 billion, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The average daily trading volume decreased $33 million over August, it said.
The weighted average value of the Chinese yuan against the U.S. dollar was 8.3017, up from 8.3063 in August.
